meta.source: viewer/shell.html and viewer/src/ui of the OpenSculptBoy repository (branch main), the sheet palette of viewer/src/sheet/compose.ts and the UX revamp proposal; version 2 recolours the system as marble: veined white stone (light) and nero marquina (dark), with bronze and verdigris; version 3 added kintsugi gold; version 4 cuts it like stone: Cinzel inscriptional capitals, Phosphor Light icons, 2 to 4px corners, a strict 4px spacing scale, and kintsugi kept to the brand mark, the welcome card and empty states; version 5 builds every component on shadcn/ui (Radix primitives), uses the project's own logo, and shapes panels as slabs and the mode bar as a lintel

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground under the canvas and behind every panel: white Carrara stone in light, nero marquina in dark.

tokens.name: stage-centre
tokens.usage: Centre of the canvas backdrop (centred at 50 % across and 56 % down). Also the ground of slot and starter thumbnails.

tokens.name: stage-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the canvas backdrop. The radial gradient from stage-centre to stage-edge is the only gradient in the system; large grounds add the vein texture (osb-veins) over it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Solid panels: menus, dialogs, toasts, cards, the start screen.

tokens.name: panel-glass
tokens.usage: Floating panels over the canvas, always with an 18px backdrop blur (blur-glass). Dense enough that no vein shows behind text.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards and slots at rest on a panel.

tokens.name: raised-2
tokens.usage: Hover of buttons, cards and icon buttons; the key cap of a key hint.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Sunken grounds: segmented controls, fields, an open fold, the sheet view's backdrop.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Fine rules: panel borders, dividers between groups and over a panel's foot, card and slot borders at rest. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hover borders, menu and tooltip borders, the slider track, the switch outline.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen (3:1 on panel and raised): fields, the drop zone's dashes, empty slots.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, panel, panel-glass, raised, raised-2 and accent-soft (12:1 and more).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels at rest, notes, icons at rest. 5.3:1 or more on every ground listed for text.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: slider ends, meta lines, key caps of hints, on ground, panel, panel-glass and raised only (4.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Kintsugi gold. The chosen state (a fine gold rule under the current mode's raised slab, a gold edge on the chosen slot), the slider fill from the default to the value, the one primary button of a region, links. 4.7:1 on white marble and 8.4:1 on nero marquina, so it holds text. Maps to shadcn's --primary.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover of accent fills, the icon of the chosen mode, the slider's value bubble, the count of a changed fold.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the chosen mode, sub-tab, segment, chip, card or slot, always with accent-line.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Border or inset ring of the chosen state; the border of a focused field.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-strong fills (5.4:1 and more).

tokens.name: seam
tokens.usage: The body of a kintsugi repair: the base of its gold gradient. Kintsugi appears only in the welcome card's marble band and empty states, drawn as hand-shaped seams; never on the logo, never as a divider, never across text or the canvas.

tokens.name: seam-hi
tokens.usage: The sheen of a kintsugi repair, where the light catches the raised gold. Never alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Verdigris. Keyboard focus ring only: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every control. The one focus colour, so focus never looks like the gold of the chosen state.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Done states: the refined ring, a finished build, a fit that passed. Always with a glyph and a word.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Errors: the error toast's text, an error's glyph and heading. Always with a glyph and a word.

tokens.name: bad-line
tokens.usage: Border of an error toast and an error message.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the canvas behind dialogs and the start screen.

tokens.name: tip
tokens.usage: Ground of tooltips; dark stone in both themes.

tokens.name: tip-text
tokens.usage: Text on tip.

tokens.name: mark-default
tokens.usage: The tick on a slider track at the default value.

tokens.name: vein
tokens.usage: Colour of the marble veins drawn by osb-veins on large grounds (the canvas, the start screen). Drawn at 5 to 6 % opacity and never under text.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Ground of a character sheet page on paper, in both themes.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper: captions, section eyebrows.

tokens.name: paper-line
tokens.usage: Rules and the ground line on paper.

tokens.name: sheet-grey
tokens.usage: The sheet's default grey ground (COLOURS.grey in viewer/src/sheet/compose.ts).

tokens.name: sheet-grey-ink
tokens.usage: The character's name on the grey sheet (7:1 or more).

tokens.name: sheet-grey-muted
tokens.usage: Labels on the grey sheet (4.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: sheet-grey-line
tokens.usage: Rules and the ground line on the grey sheet.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The start screen's title. One per screen.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Dialog titles, the character's name on a sheet.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The mode's heading, the Character panel's heading, the name beside the logo.

styles.name: title-s
styles.usage: Panel headings on phones, card titles in Export.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Group labels inside a panel. Cinzel draws every letter as a capital.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, error and empty-state headings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Humanoid 3D characters for free, unlimited creativity.
styles.usage: Leads and messages. One line where a view needs it.

styles.name: mode
styles.usage: The six mode buttons in the top bar.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Slider labels, switch rows, fold titles, tile names.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Moved 2 pieces out of the skin.
styles.usage: Notes, meta lines, slider ends. The smallest text on the page.

styles.name: numeral-l
styles.usage: One large count per view: a build's or a fit's share.

styles.name: numeral-s
styles.usage: Slot numbers on their plate and step numbers, in Roman numerals where the count is small (I to XII).

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Slider value fields and changing numbers (tabular figures).

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Key caps in tooltips, the help and the command list.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between the buttons of a segmented control; between a label and its note.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, buttons in a row and tiles; icon to label; the gap between floating panels and the canvas edges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between controls inside a group; between top-bar groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between sliders in a list; inner padding of cards and slots' captions.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of a panel's head and foot rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel side padding; padding of dialogs and cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups of a panel, so proximity shows what belongs together.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gutters of the start screen and of Export.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Outer margin of dialogs over the canvas.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: The canvas frame, the picture frame, the sheet page and the marble bands.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, chips, segments, key caps, tags, tiles' thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Slots, cards, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Floating panels and dialogs: crisp stone edges.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only for avatars (the character's dot, colour swatches) and toggles (the switch).

tokens.name: top-h
tokens.usage: Height of the top bar.

tokens.name: top-h-phone
tokens.usage: Height of the top bar on phones.

tokens.name: tab-h
tokens.usage: Height of the phone bar of six modes (plus the safe area).

tokens.name: insp-w
tokens.usage: Width of the mode panel on the left: 24px padding each side around a 288px column.

tokens.name: char-w
tokens.usage: Width of the Character panel on the right.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Width of the mode rail at widths from 720 to 1100px.

tokens.name: hit
tokens.usage: Height and minimum width of icon buttons and mode buttons with a fine pointer.

tokens.name: hit-touch
tokens.usage: The same with a coarse pointer.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of text buttons, chips, fields and segmented controls.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Height of every list row: folds, switch rows, Character panel rows, landmark rows.

tokens.name: slider-h
tokens.usage: Height of a slider row: a 20px label line, a 4px gap and a 24px track line.

tokens.name: track-h
tokens.usage: Slider track, a fine carved groove (the filled part 2px of accent).

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Slider thumb: a square turned on its point, a lozenge.

tokens.name: chamfer
tokens.usage: The cut corners of primary buttons and of the welcome card's band.

tokens.name: focus-w
tokens.usage: Width and offset of the focus ring.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur under panel-glass.

tokens.name: slot-thumb
tokens.usage: Height of a slot's thumbnail in a three-column grid of the panel.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and rows (16px in small buttons, 24px in tiles, 32px on cards).

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Slider thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-tip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The view bar and the phone bar over the canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts, floating cards.

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: The sheet page in the layout view.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the start screen's cards over the scrim.

tokens.name: duration-tip
tokens.usage: Tooltip fade, after duration-tip-wait.

tokens.name: duration-tip-wait
tokens.usage: Wait before a tooltip shows, so a passing pointer shows nothing.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and border changes on hover and press; switch knob; fold chevron.

tokens.name: duration-panel
tokens.usage: A panel slides 8px in and fades in.

tokens.name: duration-toast
tokens.usage: A toast pops in; tiles pop in.

tokens.name: duration-move
tokens.usage: Bars that move with the layout; progress fills.

tokens.name: duration-fade
tokens.usage: The interface fades in once the character is ready.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Hover, fades and moves.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Things that arrive: toasts, a slot that fills, tiles. Never on the canvas.
